F2.evidence: tool-cards.css:132 now sets .chat-tool-row__chevron opacity:0 and the only reveal rules (tool-cards.css:228-241) require a .chat-inline-disclosure ancestor or a file/subagent row; the Chevron in chat-handoff-sessions.tsx:61 sits inside .chat-subagent-wait__toggle / .chat-handoff-resume__rule buttons that have neither, and no other stylesheet (layout.css:3750, working-indicator.css) sets its opacity.
